purpose: Record reproducible NR fluctuation candidates without claiming that either is confirmed as the exact 2026 analysis setting.

paper_status.table_s5: Publishes the 15-parameter NR mean light-/charge-yield model.
paper_status.nr_fluctuation_vector: No separate NRERWidthsParam vector is tabulated in Table S5 or present in the user-supplied 46-table HEPData ZIP.
paper_status.interpretation: The 2026 paper uses NEST v2.4.5 and says best-fit NEST response parameters are in the Data Release. The inspected ZIP is a tabular export and contains no separate NEST configuration file.

nr_relevant_indices.3: NR recombination-fluctuation center in electron fraction
nr_relevant_indices.11: linear energy/quanta dependence of ion Fano factor
nr_relevant_indices.12: linear energy/quanta dependence of exciton Fano factor

generic_nest_default.status: Upstream generic NEST default; not evidence of a fitted LZ 2026 setting.

lz_ws2024_tuned.source_comment: The detector file identifies itself as LZ SR3 or WS2024 and says the listed vectors were adjusted to match LZ tritium and D-D calibration data. It recommends NEST v2.4.0.
lz_ws2024_tuned.status: LZ-specific calibration-tuned candidate; stronger provenance than generic defaults, but not confirmed as the exact 2026 extended-NR analysis configuration.

comparison.note: The two candidates are close for the NR-relevant entries. Indices 6-10 are ER-specific in the GetQuanta NR branch; they are retained in the full vector because the NEST API requires a 13-element vector.

implementation_evidence.nr_usage: For Lindhard < 1, GetQuanta uses indices 0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 11, and 12 through the ion/exciton Fano terms, RecombOmegaNR, and NR skewness.
implementation_evidence.warning: This source-code audit identifies available candidate settings; it does not prove which vector the LZ 2026 collaboration used in the final analysis.

recommended_use.baseline: Run the LZ_WS2024-tuned vector as the primary documented candidate and generic NEST defaults as a comparison.
recommended_use.production_gate: Do not label either result as an exact LZ 2026 detector-response reproduction until the 2026 configuration or an explicit collaboration statement confirms the choice and detector settings.

detector_response_candidate.source_description: LZ SR3/WS2024 detector class; source comment says tuned to tritium and D-D calibration data and recommends NEST v2.4.0.
caveats: The detector file recommends NEST v2.4.0; the 2026 paper states NEST v2.4.5.
The old 12-entry mean-yield vector in the detector class must be overridden by the 15-entry 2026 Table S5 vector.
The 2026 Table S4 double-skewed-Gaussian ER fluctuation model is not represented by the 13-entry WS2024 width vector.
The class's analytic spatial corrections have not been proven identical to the 2026 final spatial response.
detector_response_candidate.recommended_role: Primary candidate for an NR-only event-level pilot, with generic NEST NR-width defaults as a controlled comparison; not an exact 2026 response claim.
